title.en: The One With My Favorite Fine Lady

description.es: Marta y Fina regresan de visitar el piso que Fina planea alquilar. Aunque a Marta no le convence la opción, Fina insiste en que lo importante es poder costearlo por sí misma. Marta le confiesa que la extrañará en la casa grande y, justo cuando están a punto de compartir un beso, Manuela las interrumpe, obligando a Marta a esconderse para no ser descubiertas.
description.en: Marta and Fina come back from seeing the apartment Fina plans to rent. Although Marta is not convinced by the option, Fina insists that what matters is being able to afford it herself. Marta confesses that she will miss her at the big house and, just as they are about to share a kiss, Manuela interrupts them, forcing Marta to hide so they are not discovered.
